wallet_identity_load_failed: Unable to read the wallet identity. Check your network connection and try again.
wallet_identity_incomplete: The wallet identity is incomplete or does not match the selected account.
wallet_identity_help: In BuckyOSApp, create, import or select a BNS identity, then retry here.
use_buckyos_sn: All traffic is encrypted and forwarded through SN relay service.
bucky_forward_desc: Route encrypted traffic to your PI device through the BuckyOS SN Web3 bridge.
bucky_forward_benefit1: A simple setup lets your PI work in standard browsers.
direct_connect_desc: Public access will reach your PI device without relay.
public_ip_desc: Usually for VPS deployments; traffic does not go through SN relay.
public_ip_hint: Make sure ports 80, 443, and 2980 on this device are publicly reachable.
port_mapping_full: I have mapped ports 443 and 2980 to this device, or this device has a public IPv6 address
port_mapping_rtcp_only: I can only map port 2980 (or other) to this device
port_mapping_full_hint: All traffic will reach this device directly without going through SN relay
port_mapping_rtcp_only_hint:
Browser traffic will go through SN relay
RTCP traffic from clients can reach this device directly
For example, traffic from buckyos desktop on another laptop can access this device directly without SN relay.
error_invalid_port: Invalid port number, please enter a number between 1-65535
mnemonic_generate_intro: Generate one recovery phrase for both your Owner identity and BNS asset-owner wallet.
mnemonic_backup_warning: Write these 12 words down in order. They are the only recovery method for this identity.
evm_asset_owner_hint: This recoverable EVM address owns your BNS name.
owner_registration_complete: Your Owner identity and BNS name have been registered.
error_password_mismatch: The two passwords entered do not match
domain_placeholder: Enter the domain to be used
host_account_hint: Agents you enable for the host run commands on this machine as this account. Other Agents are not affected. A normal account cannot use sudo from an Agent.
host_account_none: None (Agents cannot run commands on this machine)
host_account_root_warning: Agents you enable for the host will have full control of this machine, and anyone who takes over your owner account gets the same control. Choose root only to let an Agent maintain this machine.
error_copy_failed: Copy failed. Please copy it manually.
error_open_failed: Could not open the browser. Please copy the link and open it manually.
activating_hint: Documents are being published and written to this device. Keep this page open.
activating_hint_challenge: A test record is confirming that the certificate can be issued. Public DNS can take about 4 minutes. Keep this page open.
error_name_registered: This name is already registered. If it is yours, choose "I already registered".
restore_intro: Enter the username, password and recovery phrase you registered with. Activation continues from the domain step.
restore_mnemonic_hint: 12 words in order, separated by spaces.
sn_error_invalid_password: The username or password is wrong.
sn_error_user_auth_not_found: The username or password is wrong.
sn_error_user_not_activated: This account is not active on SN.
sn_error_email_already_bound: This email is already used by another account.
title_step_gateway: Choose how this device is reached
public_ip_confirm: Check that this is the address the Internet reaches this device at.
public_ip_not_found: No public address was found on this device. Enter it here.
error_public_ipv6: Enter a public IPv6 address, or leave it empty.
region_existing_account: An existing account keeps its relay. It cannot be changed here.
use_own_domain_desc: For example home.example.com. DNS can be managed by SN, through your DNS service's API, or by yourself.
domain_delegated_to_sn: The NS of this domain already points to SN.
domain_dns_other: DNS is hosted at {{servers}} (not a service with API support here)
domain_already_bound: This domain is bound to your account.
mode_sn_desc: Add one TXT record, then one NS record. SN answers everything else and the certificate is issued automatically.
mode_dns_api_desc: Enter your DNS service's API token. The system writes the records and renews the certificate.
mode_manual_desc: Add the records yourself and upload your own wildcard certificate.
blocked_apex: A root domain cannot be managed by SN: its MX and other records would be lost. Use a subdomain, such as home.example.com.
blocked_apex_needs_subdomain: A root domain cannot carry a CNAME record. Use a subdomain, or go back and choose a fixed public IP.
sn_step_txt: 1. Add this TXT record at your current DNS service. It proves the domain is yours.
sn_step_ns_locked: 2. The NS record appears here after ownership has passed.
sn_step_ns: 2. Ownership has passed. Now add this NS record; it hands the domain over to SN.
sn_withdraw_ns_hint: The NS of this domain already points to SN, so SN cannot see the TXT record. Delete the NS record for now, wait until ownership has passed, then add it back.
manual_records_intro: Add these records at the DNS service of {{zone}}. On Cloudflare, set them to "DNS only".
dns_record_relative: If the DNS console adds {{zone}} by itself, enter {{name}} as the name.
dns_record_conflict: This name already has: {{existing}}. Delete it first, then add the record above.
dns_provider_experimental_hint: This service has not been tried with a real account yet. Check the records in its console after writing.
dns_provider_account_scope: A token of this service reaches a whole account or project, not just this domain.
dns_provider_other: If your service is not listed, use "Managed by SN" with a subdomain, or "Manual" if you have a certificate.
dns_token_storage: The token is stored only on this device. It is used to renew the certificate and repair the records.
dns_token_kept: The token for {{provider}} is on this device.
dns_write_conflict: Already there and will be replaced: {{existing}}
dns_write_scope: Only the names above are changed. An existing record that is not ticked stays as it is.
cert_intro: The certificate must contain both {{domain}} and {{wildcard}}. Accepted: PEM files, pasted PEM text, or PFX / P12. Two certificates, one per name, also work.
cert_paste_label: Or paste PEM text (certificate, intermediates, private key)
cert_ready: The certificate can be used. It is installed when you activate.
cert_expires: Expires on {{date}}. Replace it before then, or browsers cannot open your Zone.
cert_accept_warnings: I have read this and want to use the certificate
cert_not_managed: The system does not renew an uploaded certificate and does not remind you.
cert_untrusted_title: This certificate is not publicly trusted. That affects:
cert_untrusted_browser: Browsers and phones without this CA show a security warning.
cert_untrusted_zone: Other Zones cannot verify this Zone; cross-Zone features do not work.
cert_untrusted_check: The check after activation may not see that it succeeded.
cert_reason_unparsable: These files could not be recognized. Use PEM, DER or PFX / P12.
cert_reason_key_missing: The private key is missing. Choose the key file as well.
cert_reason_key_encrypted: The private key is protected by a password. Remove the password, or use a PFX file.
cert_reason_key_mismatch: The private key does not belong to this certificate.
cert_reason_parent_wildcard: A wildcard of the parent domain covers {{domain}} but not its subdomains, such as notes.{{domain}}. You need {{wildcard}}, or use the parent domain as the Zone domain.
cert_reason_single_domain: This is a single-domain certificate without {{wildcard}}; apps could not be opened. You need a wildcard certificate.
cert_reason_wildcard_only: {{wildcard}} does not include {{domain}} itself. Upload a second certificate for {{domain}}, or have the CA add it to the SAN.
cert_reason_ev: An EV certificate cannot contain a wildcard name. Use an OV or DV wildcard certificate.
cert_reason_not_covered: The certificate does not contain this name.
cert_reason_not_yet_valid: Not valid yet. This device's clock: {{time}}.
cert_reason_expires_soon: Expires on {{date}}, in less than 30 days.
cert_reason_no_server_auth: The certificate is not meant for server authentication.
cert_reason_is_ca: It is marked as a CA certificate, which some clients reject. Self-signed certificates often are.
cert_reason_self_signed: Self-signed: only clients that trust it can connect.
cert_reason_chain_not_public: The chain does not reach a public root: an intermediate is missing, or it is a private CA. Only clients that trust it can connect.
cert_reason_unsupported_key: Use RSA with 2048 bits or more, or ECDSA P-256 / P-384.
check_auto: Checked automatically every 10 seconds. You can continue once everything has passed.
check_wait_hint: DNS services can take from a few minutes to a few hours.
code_txt_missing: The TXT record is not on the authoritative DNS yet. Add it and wait for the DNS service.
code_txt_mismatch: The TXT record has a different value. Replace it with the expected one.
code_bind_invalid_domain: SN does not accept this domain. Check the spelling.
code_bind_domain_proof_failed: The TXT record is there, but SN does not see it yet. This is tried again automatically. If the NS of the domain already points to SN, delete the NS record for now.
code_bind_user_not_found: SN has no such account. Check the username.
code_bind_user_not_activated: The SN account is not active.
code_bind_auth_required: The SN session is no longer valid. It is renewed automatically; with a wallet, authorize again.
code_bind_invalid_token: The SN session is no longer valid. It is renewed automatically; with a wallet, authorize again.
code_bind_internal_error: SN has a temporary problem. This is tried again automatically.
code_bind_other: SN did not accept the domain. This is tried again automatically.
code_ns_missing: The parent domain has no NS record handing this domain to SN yet. Add it and wait for the DNS service.
code_ns_extra: There are other NS records for this domain. Keep only the expected one.
code_ns_not_answering: Public resolvers cannot reach this domain through SN yet. Wait a few minutes; if the parent domain uses DNSSEC, remove a leftover DS record of this domain.
code_record_missing: The record is not there yet.
code_record_mismatch: The record has a different value. Change it to the expected one.
code_record_conflict: This name has another record. Delete it, then add the expected one.
code_stale_record: This name has its own older record, which hides the wildcard record. Delete it.
code_proxied: The record is proxied. Set it to "DNS only" in Cloudflare.
code_apex_needs_subdomain: A root domain cannot carry a CNAME record. Use a subdomain, or choose a fixed public IP.
code_caa_denied: The CAA records do not allow Let's Encrypt. Add an issue record for letsencrypt.org, or upload a certificate.
code_certificate_missing: There is no certificate yet. Upload one and check it.
code_certificate_rejected: The certificate did not pass. Use another one.
code_challenge_write_failed: The TXT record for the certificate challenge could not be written. Check what the token is allowed to do.
code_challenge_not_visible: The challenge record was written but public DNS does not show it yet. Wait for the DNS service; if it stays like this, check DNSSEC and NS.
code_challenge_busy: Another check is using the challenge record. This is tried again automatically.
code_credential_missing: This device does not have the token anymore. Enter it again.
code_credential_rejected: The DNS service rejected the token. Check that it is complete, not expired, and may edit DNS.
code_credential_invalid: The token is not in the right format. Check every field.
code_zone_not_found: The token cannot reach this domain. Check its scope and the account the domain is in.
code_rate_limited: The DNS service limits requests. Try again a little later.
code_network: This device cannot reach the DNS service's API. Check its network and try again.
code_provider_error: The DNS service returned an error. Try again later.
code_no_session: Ownership cannot be confirmed without an SN session. With a wallet, authorize it; otherwise sign-in is tried again automatically.
code_lookup_failed: DNS could not be queried. This device must be able to reach authoritative DNS servers on port 53. This is tried again automatically.
code_commit_time: Confirmed with a test record when you activate. Nothing to do now.
code_dns_lookup_failed: The DNS of this domain could not be found. Check the spelling and this device's network.
code_domain_not_ready: Some domain checks have not passed. Go back to the domain step.
code_sn_challenge_failed: The certificate challenge failed: public DNS does not show the test record written to SN. Make sure the NS record is in effect, then activate again in a few minutes.
code_certificate_warning_unconfirmed: The certificate has warnings to confirm. Go back to the domain step.
code_mnemonic_invalid: The recovery phrase is not valid. Enter the 12 words in order and check the spelling.
code_owner_not_found: BNS has no identity for this username. Check it; if you just registered, try again in a few minutes.
code_owner_document_invalid: The identity document of this account on BNS is not valid.
code_owner_key_invalid: The key of this account on BNS is not valid.
code_mnemonic_owner_mismatch: This recovery phrase does not belong to this account.
code_domain_not_found: This domain is not registered, or its DNS is not set up. Check the spelling.
code_invalid_setup: These settings do not fit together. Go back and check the access route and the domain.
code_bns_unavailable: BNS cannot be reached right now. Try again later.
code_bind_unavailable: SN cannot be reached right now. This is tried again automatically.
code_certificate_unreadable: The files could not be read. Choose them again.
code_install_failed: The certificate could not be installed on this device. Try again.
code_certificate_too_large: The files are larger than 1 MB in total.
code_unknown: This did not pass. Try again.
wallet_signing_review: The wallet asks you to sign twice.
web_signing_review: When you activate, four documents are signed on this device with your recovery phrase.
result_starting_hint: The first start takes about 2 minutes. Keep this page open.
result_qr_hint: Scan with your phone to open it
result_cause_node: The node could not be reached. It may not have finished starting.
result_cause_dns: The domain does not resolve yet.
result_cause_service: The node and the domain are fine, but the certificate or the forwarding is not ready.
result_hint_tunnel: If you activated through an SSH tunnel, this is normal. Check on the server.
result_hint_dns: It may be the DNS cache on this device. Try another network, or again later.
result_hint_loopback: If you are on the same local network as the node, your router may not let you reach its own public IP from inside. Try with mobile data.
result_unverifiable_hint: Your certificate is not publicly trusted, so this page cannot check it. Open the address and look for yourself.
check_leave_hint: You can leave for your DNS console. If this page gets closed, open it again and choose "I already registered" to continue.
cert_confirm_pending: The checks have passed. Confirm the certificate's warnings above to continue.
